description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer tab-stop checkpoint: safe Rust owns default/reset, ordered unique add/clear, forward/reverse navigation, edge clamping, and the main/alternate shared tab-stop state.

entries.notes: TabStops initializes every eight columns, clears all stops, and restores defaults for both RIS/DECST8C reset observables.
Ordered BTreeSet ownership matches head/middle/tail insertion and duplicate suppression.
Clearing empty, singleton, head, middle, tail and nonexistent stops matches Microsoft's vectors.
Forward navigation selects the next strictly-greater stop and clamps to the rightmost buffer column.
Reverse navigation selects the previous strictly-smaller stop and clamps to column zero.
SharedTabStops clones the same safe owner so alternate-buffer mutations remain visible after returning to the main buffer, matching the source contract.
